subject.title: improve(control-ui): expose linear session positions in chat picker

question: Should maintainers land this narrow Control UI picker accessibility slice now, after refresh and required checks, while keeping the broader linear workspace issue open?
rationale: The patch is focused and proven, but it changes user-facing accessibility copy/UX under a maintainer-protected label and only partially addresses a broader product-direction issue.

options.title: Land narrow slice
options.body: Approve this selector affordance after the branch is refreshed and required checks pass, without treating it as the full solution to the broader workspace request.

options.title: Ask for UX changes
options.body: Request different wording, ordinal presentation, or screen-reader phrasing before merge if maintainers want a different accessibility pattern.

options.title: Pause for broader design
options.body: Hold this PR until the full linear workspace accessibility direction is designed, accepting that the smaller picker improvement waits.

recommendation.title: Land narrow slice
recommendation.body: Approve this selector affordance after the branch is refreshed and required checks pass, without treating it as the full solution to the broader workspace request.
